scope: All three canonical specs (53 requirements), all83 authored cases, shared research, retained manual chapter bodies, rendered support text, source/package records, snapshots and author manifest. No release, application or extracted execution review.

findings.problem: The setup only requires an assigned groove, while the expected result/comparator requires MIDI movement and marker/note edit presence. The comparator adds a nonzero timing setup, but a nonzero Timing control does not guarantee displacement: the same draft REQ-GROOVE-004 and retained G3 explicitly say a grid-aligned groove contributes no displacement. Committing an identity result can correctly reset assignment without producing the required visible note edit. Audio may likewise already have appropriate markers; no new-marker count/identity policy is established.
evidence: manual-12-using-grooves.txt:0035 (grid-aligned groove contributes no timing displacement)
manual-12-using-grooves.txt:0050–0051 (Commit writes result and resets assignment)
findings.requested_change: Give the MIDI case a documented nonidentity setup, for example the existing0.1/0.6-beat inputs with Base1/8, Quantize100 and Timing/Random/Velocity0, then compare committed note positions0/0.5 and assignmentNone. For audio, grade only the supported assignment/appropriate-marker subset with explicit input-marker preconditions, or keep marker-change details U. Do not infer that nonzero Timing alone forces edits.

findings.problem: The word independently can be read as statistical independence between voices. Retained G3 documents differing per-voice randomization, without specifying a joint distribution or cross-voice correlation law. GRV-007 correctly remains U and explicitly rejects a statistical threshold, so no passing statistical oracle currently follows.
findings.requested_change: Prefer separately per voice and explicitly leave statistical independence/cross-voice correlation U. Preserve the current no-guaranteed-separation and no-RNG-oracle limits.

findings.problem: The case fixes Pressure UI values20,40,30 although the spec explicitly leaves expression UI domains/scaling unknown and the cited prose supplies no such admissibility range. The Edit Value property is documented, but the scenario should not silently certify those particular inputs as accepted.
findings.requested_change: At fixture refinement use three distinct confirmed-accepted interior Pressure UI values or state accepted-value preconditions symbolically, then compare the displayed entered value. Keep invalid/range/codec behavior U; do not derive Pressure units from note storage.
